title: FastLanes
relevance: Redesigns lightweight encodings to be fully data-parallel, achieving 100+ billion integers/second decode speed. Introduces Expression Encoding for composable codec pipelines.

title: libdeflate: Heavily optimized DEFLATE/zlib/gzip compression and decompression
relevance: Current gold standard for sequential DEFLATE decompression. Uses 2-tier Huffman tables and hand-optimized C with SIMD. The baseline to beat.

title: Understanding the Huffman Table Optimization
relevance: Explains the multi-level Huffman table lookup optimization used in WebP and other codecs, applicable to DEFLATE table design.

title: Towards Compression At All Levels In The Memory Hierarchy
venue: PhD Thesis, Universite de Rennes 1 / INRIA
relevance: Comprehensive analysis of compression across cache hierarchy levels, providing theoretical framework for memory-layout-aware compression.
